name: Aqarios
description: Aqarios provides a cloud-based quantum computing platform called Luna for solving real-world optimization, simulation, and machine learning problems. Spun off from the QAR-Lab at LMU Munich, the company partners with IBM Quantum hardware and works with industrial clients including SAP, BASF, E.ON, and MTU Aero Engines.
funding: ~USD 140M via SPAC (Fonterelli SPAC 4 AG); publicly traded on Düsseldorf Stock Exchange (July 2026)

products.name: Luna Platform
products.description: Quantum optimization software with IBM Quantum and NVIDIA CUDA-Q backend integrations

products.name: FlexQAOA
products.description: Constraint-aware quantum optimization algorithm embedding constraints directly into quantum circuits

highlights: Won Quantum Effects Award 2025 in Software & Algorithms category
Spin-off from QAR-Lab at LMU Munich

news.excerpt: Aqarios Quantum Technologies AG has begun trading on the Düsseldorf Stock Exchange following its SPAC merger with Fonterelli SPAC 4 AG.

news.title: Aqarios Launches Quantum Platform Luna to Bring Quantum Applications Closer to End Users
news.excerpt: After a successful closed beta phase, Luna is now available to the public, providing businesses, developers, and researchers with access to a comprehensive suite of quantum tools enabling faster innovation, problem-solving, and efficiency across industries.

news.title: Aqarios Lists on Düsseldorf Stock Exchange as Germany's First Pure-Play Public Quantum Computing Company
news.excerpt: Aqarios Quantum Technologies AG completed its SPAC merger with Fonterelli SPAC 4 AG and began trading on the Düsseldorf Stock Exchange on July 14, 2026, raising approximately $140M and becoming Germany's first publicly listed pure-play quantum computing company.
